messages.content: Help me generate a dynamic chart with user-provided data `userDataArray` and apply a scaling factor of 3 for the axis values, linking it to a given dashboard `dashboardElement`?

function.name: DynamicChartGenerator
function.description: This function creates a dynamic chart based on user input, applies a scaling factor to the axis values, and integrates the chart into a specified dashboard for display. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

userData.description: The data provided by the user to plot on the chart. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

scalingFactor.description: A scaling factor applied to the chart's axis values. Optional parameter. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

dashboard.description: The dashboard where the chart will be displayed. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

options.description: Additional configuration options for the chart. Default empty dict This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation.
